source_locators.boundary: The tau in a one-transition radiative formula is not automatically the total parent mean lifetime when other photon and non-gamma branches exist. The absolute branch bookkeeping below is our definition-based reconstruction.

same_pair_definitions.case: Fixed2+->2+ initial/final multiplets; full photon modes M1/E2/M3/E4, retained M1/E2 and omitted M3/E4.
same_pair_definitions.Gamma_gamma: Integrated TOTAL PHOTON width for this one pair, Gamma_ret+Gamma_om; it is not total parent width, total pair deexcitation width including IC/E0, or the sum of photon widths to other final states.
same_pair_definitions.independent_floor: Gamma_gamma>=Gamma_gamma_min>0 in the same full adopted model, independently established; no target-truncation-dependent fit may be used as its own premise.
same_pair_definitions.independent_omission_ceiling: 0<=Gamma_om<=U_om<infinity for every omitted photon mode. One sufficient numerator from the earlier controlled route is U_om=C3 q^7 BM3max+C4 q^9 BE4max; its support/current/moment and operator-validity conditions remain.
same_pair_definitions.units: Gamma and U are energy widths. T_gamma is inverse time and Gamma=hbar*T_gamma. Both floor and ceiling must use the same width convention/units.

theorem.strict_threshold: If U_om<Gamma_gamma_min then Gamma_ret>0, so the normalized retained reference exists without an additional E2 floor.
theorem.equality_or_excess: At U_om>=Gamma_gamma_min the fraction ceiling is1 and retained positivity is not guaranteed. If a retained state exists from other information the old error bound is at best trivial; if Gamma_ret=0 it is undefined.
theorem.proof: Nonnegative widths, positive full-width floor and division by that floor give the fraction bound. Subtracting the omission ceiling gives the retained floor. Strict inequality supplies positive S_R.
theorem.zero_edges: U_om=0 gives epsilon0 and identical retained/full states. A zero/negative photon-width floor or negative omission ceiling is not an input to this theorem. Gamma_gamma=0 has no emitted-photon normalization; q0 with finite adopted moments cannot meet a positive photon-width floor.

observable_connection.strict_regime: For U_om<Gamma_gamma_min, common-rho full radiation and its unchanged retained projection have D<=sqrt(U_om/Gamma_gamma_min).
observable_connection.probability: Any same fixed effect0<=E<=I in the common normalized emitted-radiation comparison has absolute probability error<=sqrt(U_om/Gamma_gamma_min). This is not a per-parent-decay unnormalized yield bound.
observable_connection.density: In the fixed2->2 common full four-mode H_emit including final spin, |DeltaW(n)|<=5sqrt(U_om/Gamma_gamma_min). W has angular average1; per-steradian density divides the bound by4pi.
observable_connection.tolerance: For0<etaP<1, U_om<=etaP^2*Gamma_gamma_min is sufficient and implies strict retained positivity. For0<etaW<5 use U_om<=(etaW/5)^2*Gamma_gamma_min.
observable_connection.required_model_conditions: Keep identical initial rho, retained amplitudes, current/state model, positive transition energy and common normalized radial/time mode or angular-shell space. Do not refit amplitudes/rho or recompute physical time/line-shape/IC channels and claim the same state bound.
observable_connection.limits: Different rho requires an additional D_initial; generic output-support or inverse response requires its own operator audit. Relative nodes, conditional polarization denominators, fitted-parameter confidence intervals and finite-count significance are not controlled.

absolute_radiative_branch_lifetime_route.identity: For an isolated parent with intrinsic exponential mean lifetime tau and complete decay rate inventory: b_rad=T_pair,gamma/T_parent,total is the absolute probability of THIS photon transition per parent decay. Gamma_pair,gamma=hbar*b_rad/tau.
absolute_radiative_branch_lifetime_route.parent_vs_partial: tau refers to all parent decay channels, not just this pair. The photon partial lifetime is tau_gamma=tau/b_rad when b_rad>0. A half-life must first be converted to mean tau=T_half/log(2).
absolute_radiative_branch_lifetime_route.joint_domain: An independently supported jointly feasible set F in0<=b_rad<=1,tau>0 gives Gamma_gamma_min<=hbar*inf_F(b_rad/tau). The infimum must be positive for this route; preserve covariance/constraints rather than assuming marginal extrema are jointly attained.
absolute_radiative_branch_lifetime_route.rectangle_enclosure: If F is enclosed by b_rad>=b_min>0 andtau<=tau_max<infinity, hbar*b_min/tau_max is a conservative positive floor. It is sharp only if that corner belongs to F.

rectangle_control.reference_units: Gamma_ref=hbar/tau_ref; no physical hbar or time value assigned.

correlated_control.domain: b_rad=tau/(4tau_ref), tau/tau_ref in[1,3]; thus b_rad in[1/4,3/4].
correlated_control.meaning: Exact joint constraints can give a stronger floor than an enclosing rectangle; these are teaching constraints, not data confidence sets.

absolute_radiative_branch_lifetime_route.not_a_floor: A total parent lifetime alone, total deexcitation branch including conversion/E0, or intensity normalized only among observed parent photons does not supply b_rad. Absolute calibration, complete branch inventory and photon/non-gamma decomposition are additional inputs.
absolute_radiative_branch_lifetime_route.E0_IC_boundary: For this same-spin/parity pair E0 electrons can contribute without a photon, and IC from allowed photon multipoles also contributes to total branching. No atomic coefficients or energies are looked up; no measured decomposition is claimed.
absolute_radiative_branch_lifetime_route.independence: An inferred radiative branch using the target M1/E2 truncation or unvalidated ICC/model assumptions is not an independent premise. Model/operator errors must be reconciled with any measured width floor.

exact_threshold_controls.boundary: All widths are abstract nonnegative conditional assignments in common reference units; no nuclear wavefunctions/current realizing them or actual physical priors are provided.

unknown_E0_failure_family.fixed_inputs: Mean tau=tau_ref, total pair deexcitation branch1/2 and normalized parent-photon intensity1/2. The true omitted-photon ceiling U_om/Gamma_ref=1/100 holds for all controls.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Bounded Day8 L2 alternative using a same-pair total photon-width floor.

Default replay is read-only, including this owned tmp directory. The explicit
--write-receipt flag exclusively creates one new JSON; old receipts and raw
sources are never changed. All controls are exact conditional rate arithmetic,
not an experiment, software test suite or independent physical-prior evidence.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
sys.dont_write_bytecode = True

import argparse
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from fractions import Fraction as Q
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


RUN_REL = 'outputs/learning-daily/20261007-DAY8-angular-momentum-selection-rules-multipolarity-run-01'
CODE_REL = 'tmp/day8-20261007/runtime/total-gamma-width-truncation/total_gamma_width_truncation.py'
README_REL = 'tmp/day8-20261007/runtime/total-gamma-width-truncation/README.md'
OUT_REL = RUN_REL + '/total-gamma-width-truncation.json'
PRIORS = {
    'controlled_four_mode': ('controlled-four-mode-truncation.json', '0ba57d1ebd21294ecbcbccd365fa3e984215116542cb6b8676a57f6b7e527aae'),
    'probability_95': ('truncation-observable-bound.json', '8d836c358937581ae05b9923c2f222938d56cce493c4cb5056299ed550f3cec9'),
    'density_329': ('finite-rank-density-bound.json', '2636cac3929b3b28bb5b29badf5bc9df7e74d7d16378db42cb726d0bbdfe8538'),
}
RAW = {
    'LKH82': ('raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/review/1982_Lange et al_E0-E2-M1 multipole admixtures of transitions in even-even nuclei.pdf', 'ed925a0577a9257903806acd209c1db707529e86a5bfd9a301a83d597bf78ffb'),
    'RB67': ('raw/papers/gpt/high-spin-20260920/multipolarity/mixing ratio/1967_Rose et al_Angular Distributions of Gamma Rays in Terms of Phase-Defined Reduced Matrix Elements.pdf', '8f846b61b9320de291ee5600126c5e286a0fe05968df819696816f0dc1ec57dc'),
}


def digest(content):
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def width_budget(gamma_min, omitted_upper):
    gamma_min, omitted_upper = Q(gamma_min), Q(omitted_upper)
    if gamma_min <= 0 or omitted_upper < 0:
        raise ValueError('A positive photon-width floor and nonnegative omission ceiling are required')
    strict = omitted_upper < gamma_min
    return {
        'epsilon_upper': min(Q(1), omitted_upper / gamma_min),
        'retained_lower': max(Q(0), gamma_min - omitted_upper),
        'retained_reference_guaranteed': strict,
        'omitted_over_retained_upper': omitted_upper / (gamma_min - omitted_upper) if strict else None,
    }


def rectangle_gamma_domain(b_lower, b_upper, tau_lower, tau_upper, hbar=Q(1)):
    b_lower, b_upper, tau_lower, tau_upper, hbar = map(Q, (b_lower, b_upper, tau_lower, tau_upper, hbar))
    if not 0 <= b_lower <= b_upper <= 1 or not 0 < tau_lower <= tau_upper or hbar <= 0:
        raise ValueError('Invalid absolute radiative-branch/mean-lifetime feasible rectangle')
    return hbar * b_lower / tau_upper, hbar * b_upper / tau_lower


def text_budget(value):
    return {key: (str(item) if isinstance(item, Q) else item) for key, item in value.items()}


def build_receipt(root):
    checks = {}

    def check(name, value):
        checks[name] = bool(value)
        if not checks[name]:
            raise RuntimeError('Mathematical self-audit failed: ' + name)

    tracked, prior, prior_refs = {}, {}, {}
    for name, (filename, expected) in PRIORS.items():
        path = root / RUN_REL / filename
        content = path.read_bytes()
        tracked[path] = content
        check(name + '_immutable_input_identity', digest(content) == expected)
        prior[name] = json.loads(content)
        prior_refs[name] = {'path': RUN_REL + '/' + filename, 'sha256': expected}
    source_refs = []
    for name, (relative, expected) in RAW.items():
        path = root / relative
        content = path.read_bytes()
        tracked[path] = content
        check(name + '_raw_identity', digest(content) == expected)
        source_refs.append({'source': name, 'raw_path': relative, 'raw_sha256': expected})
    check('same_fixed_2_to_2_four_photon_modes', prior['controlled_four_mode']['fixed_case_and_common_model']['full_real_photon_modes'] == ['M1', 'E2', 'M3', 'E4'])
    check('same_case_emitted_space_kappa5', prior['density_329']['absolute_density_error']['case_constants']['B_2_to_2'] == '5')

    strict = width_budget(1, Q(1, 5))
    check('strict_floor_guarantees_positive_retained', strict['retained_reference_guaranteed'] and strict['retained_lower'] == Q(4, 5))
    check('strict_epsilon_and_retained_ratio_ceilings', strict['epsilon_upper'] == Q(1, 5) and strict['omitted_over_retained_upper'] == Q(1, 4))
    # An exact nonnegative width assignment with E2=0, not a nuclear realization.
    widths = {'M1': Q(4, 5), 'E2': Q(0), 'M3': Q(1, 5), 'E4': Q(0)}
    gamma = sum(widths.values(), Q(0))
    omitted = widths['M3'] + widths['E4']
    check('E2_zero_control_has_gamma_floor_and_retained_M1', gamma == 1 and widths['E2'] == 0 and widths['M1'] > 0)
    check('E2_zero_control_saturates_fraction_ceiling', omitted / gamma == strict['epsilon_upper'])
    equality, excess, zero = width_budget(1, 1), width_budget(1, 2), width_budget(1, 0)
    check('equality_does_not_guarantee_retained_reference', equality['epsilon_upper'] == 1 and equality['retained_lower'] == 0 and not equality['retained_reference_guaranteed'])
    check('above_threshold_does_not_guarantee_retained_reference', excess['epsilon_upper'] == 1 and not excess['retained_reference_guaranteed'])
    check('pure_omitted_width_fits_equality_and_excess', Q(1) >= 1 and Q(1) <= 1 and Q(1) <= 2)
    check('zero_omission_has_identical_normalized_reference', zero['epsilon_upper'] == 0 and zero['retained_lower'] == 1 and zero['retained_reference_guaranteed'])

            width_budget(*arguments)
        except ValueError:
            rejected = True
        else:
            rejected = False
        check(label + '_not_a_valid_theorem_input', rejected)

    small = width_budget(1, Q(1, 100))
    check('small_budget_probability_square_ceiling', small['epsilon_upper'] == Q(1, 100))
    check('small_budget_probability_point_error_controls', Q(1, 10) ** 2 == small['epsilon_upper'] and Q(1, 2) ** 2 == 25 * small['epsilon_upper'])
    eta = Q(1, 10)
    check('absolute_probability_tolerance_sufficiency', Q(1, 100) <= eta ** 2 * Q(1) and small['retained_reference_guaranteed'])
    low, high = rectangle_gamma_domain(Q(1, 10), Q(3, 10), 2, 5)
    check('radiative_branch_mean_tau_rectangle_gamma_bounds', low == Q(1, 50) and high == Q(3, 20))
    check('rectangle_lower_corner_is_feasible_for_the_control', Q(1, 10) / 5 == low)
    correlated = [{'tau': str(tau), 'absolute_b_rad': str(tau / 4), 'gamma_width_ratio': str((tau / 4) / tau)} for tau in (Q(1), Q(2), Q(3))]
    envelope_low, _ = rectangle_gamma_domain(Q(1, 4), Q(3, 4), 1, 3)
    check('joint_correlation_preserves_stronger_width_floor', all(Q(item['gamma_width_ratio']) == Q(1, 4) for item in correlated) and envelope_low == Q(1, 12))
    check('joint_floor_does_not_assume_independent_extrema', envelope_low < Q(1, 4))
    no_floor, _ = rectangle_gamma_domain(0, Q(3, 10), 2, 5)
    check('zero_radiative_branch_lower_envelope_supplies_no_positive_floor', no_floor == 0)

    # Photon-relative intensity and total deexcitation branching stay fixed
    # while unknown non-gamma/E0 weight makes same-pair photon width arbitrarily
    # small. All widths use Gamma_ref=hbar/tau_ref; no physical constants/data.
    family = []
    U_fixed = Q(1, 100)
    for t in (Q(1, 100), Q(1, 200), Q(1, 1000), Q(1, 10000)):
        gamma_pair = t
        electron_E0_pair = Q(1, 2) - t
        gamma_other = t

        retained_pair = t / 2
        omitted_pair = t / 2
        epsilon_actual = omitted_pair / gamma_pair
        false_gamma_floor = Q(1, 2)  # incorrectly assigns total pair branch to photons
        wrong_bound = width_budget(false_gamma_floor, U_fixed)['epsilon_upper']
        control = {
            'Gamma_pair_gamma': str(gamma_pair), 'Gamma_pair_E0_electrons': str(electron_E0_pair),
            'Gamma_other_gamma': str(gamma_other), 'Gamma_other_nongamma': str(nongamma_other),
            'parent_mean_tau_over_tau_ref': '1', 'absolute_total_pair_branch': '1/2',
            'normalized_parent_photon_intensity_pair': '1/2', 'retained_pair_gamma': str(retained_pair),
            'omitted_pair_gamma': str(omitted_pair), 'epsilon_actual': str(epsilon_actual),
            'wrong_epsilon_bound_from_total_branch': str(wrong_bound),
        }
        family.append(control)
        check('unknown_E0_' + str(t) + '_nonnegative_and_parent_lifetime_fixed', min(gamma_pair, electron_E0_pair, gamma_other, nongamma_other) >= 0 and parent_total == 1)
        check('unknown_E0_' + str(t) + '_branch_and_photon_intensity_fixed', gamma_pair + electron_E0_pair == Q(1, 2) and gamma_pair / (gamma_pair + gamma_other) == Q(1, 2))
        check('unknown_E0_' + str(t) + '_omission_ceiling_true_but_false_floor_fails', omitted_pair <= U_fixed and retained_pair > 0 and gamma_pair < false_gamma_floor and epsilon_actual > wrong_bound)
    check('unknown_E0_family_controls_have_decreasing_photon_width', Q(family[-1]['Gamma_pair_gamma']) < Q(family[0]['Gamma_pair_gamma']))

    for path, content in tracked.items():
        check(path.name + '_bytes_unchanged_after', path.read_bytes() == content)
    code_path = Path(__file__).resolve()
    code = code_path.read_bytes()
    readme_path = root / README_REL
    readme = readme_path.read_bytes() if readme_path.exists() else None
    return {
